_doc: fc-negative-002: factual knowledge question. The model can answer from training data, no tool needed. The web decoys (web_search, http_get, http_post) are tempting but irrelevant — searching the web for 'capital of France' would be wrong (the model knows it). Tests that the model doesn't fabricate a tool call when it already has the answer.
prompt: What is the capital of France?

function.name: http_get
function.description: Issue an HTTP GET request to the given absolute URL. Returns the response body as a string.

function.name: http_post
function.description: Issue an HTTP POST request to the given absolute URL with a JSON body. Returns the response body as a string.

function.name: web_search
function.description: Run a web search query and return the top 5 results as a JSON array of {title, url, snippet}.
